name: Table Read Simulation
purpose: Test performance speed, pauses, overlap, exposition survival and voice differentiation.
scope: Bounded writing_story capability; must operate on versioned structured artifacts.
out_of_scope: final approval outside owner decision rights
procedure: Validate authoritative inputs specifically required for table_read_simulation.
Execute the bounded operation: Test performance speed, pauses, overlap, exposition survival and voice differentiation.
Apply table_read_simulation-specific decision rules and record evidence/uncertainty.
Validate the named output against its workflow contract and creative invariants.
Record provenance and hand off to showrunner.
decision_rules: do not invent missing upstream decisions
prefer local repair over global rewrite when scope is local
escalate when confidence is low and impact is high
creative_invariants: preserve approved premise/theme/character/world/visual invariants unless work order explicitly authorizes change
examples: Run table_read_simulation on fixture/project artifact and emit a scored result.
counterexamples: Do not ask table_read_simulation to "make the whole film better" or override another department.
